svg.title: B1.05 · Type Of Triangle
svg.desc: One label per input triple of sides. For 13, 14 and 30, the sum of the two shorter sides is 27. That row cannot form a triangle. 20,20,20 is Equilateral and 20,21,22 is Scalene. The valid 20,20,23 still needs the two-equal label. 20,20,23 is Isosceles. The result has one label for each of the four input triples. The example follows input order.
svg.text: One label per input triple of sides.
Why must the 13, 14, 30 row face the triangle test before its side lengths get classified?
A triangle marks an example to follow. Shaded columns show what to read. SQL excerpts use … for omitted clauses.
Which triples can form a triangle?
For 13, 14 and 30, the sum of the two shorter sides is 27. That row cannot form a triangle.
WHEN A + B <= C OR A + C <= B OR B + C <= A
Which valid triples are all equal or all different?
20,20,20 is Equilateral and 20,21,22 is Scalene. The valid 20,20,23 still needs the two-equal label.
WHEN A = B AND B = C … / WHEN A != B AND B != C AND C != A …
Which label belongs to each original row?
20,20,23 is Isosceles. The result has one label for each of the four input triples. The example follows input order.
